chapter: The band's later history and Cootie Williams
title: Cootie Williams and Duke Ellington
summary: Cootie Williams started out playing with Pope in Mobile; Pope declined an invitation from Ellington as too old; Cootie's teacher was Lipscomb.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Oh, I understand. Edward Wright. Yeah. I was going to ask... did you know Cootie Williams? Yes, Cootie played with me quite a bit.

Did he play with you too? Yes, Cootie played with me quite a bit. Back he started right out playing with me right here in Mobile. Somebody once... I went to New York one time and he and Duke Ellington, they wanted me to play in his band. Oh really? As I told him about that time, I was less too old now. I couldn't compete with those fellows in the bank of that band. Those bands. Yes, Cootie played with me quite a while.
Somebody told me that Cootie's teacher was Charles Lipscomb. How do you pronounce that name? Is that the man you were telling about? Lipscomb? Lipscomb. That's right.
